objective: Preallocate Fusion storage immutable memtable buffers for the first flush.

tasks.title: Preallocate immutable memtable buffer
tasks.result: Fusion storage now creates the immutable memtable queue with capacity for the first flushed memtable.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The immutable memtable buffer capacity is 1 because the first flush pushes the first old active memtable into this queue.
The optimization only changes initial Vec allocation for the immutable memtable queue; flush visibility, SSTable registration, and scan semantics are unchanged.
